place.source_title: National Home for Disabled Volunteer Soldiers, Northwestern Branch, Single Family Dwelling (Building 47)

brief: Two-storey rectangular white clapboard staff house with attic and full basement: a steep gabled roof with a tall central brick chimney, a two-level front porch with turned posts, spindle frieze and railings on both floors, lattice skirting and wooden steps. Paint is peeling badly and the porch sags.

facade.notes: a staff house at the National Soldiers' Home (Milwaukee, 1890): a two-storey frame house with a two-level porch, sawn spindle friezes, lattice skirting, paint peeling; a big end chimney; spruces

why.note: a federal veterans' home: staff houses on its grounds
